qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Hygienic process engineering know-how and dairy/beverage/pharma installed base, but GAAP ROIC (~9.5-11%) falls short of the 12% hurdle due to competitive machinery tenders and cyclic capital project exposure, lacking pricing power >= inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Food, beverage, and dairy processing machinery group. While management reports high ROCE by excluding €800m historical goodwill and capital items, full GAAP ROIC tracks below the 12% hurdle (~9.5-11%) due to equipment tender competition and customer buyer power.
qualitative.evidence: Statutory EBIT margins track between 7.5% and 10.3%. Reported ROCE is inflated by narrow asset definitions, while true GAAP ROIC sits around 9.5-11%, failing the 12% multi-cycle hurdle. Equipment orders remain cyclical and exposed to dairy/beverage capex swings.
